# weYou World — AI-powered websites, wired from day one

> weYou World designs and engineers AI-native websites and digital platforms for businesses worldwide. Payments (Stripe, Razorpay), CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce), messaging (WhatsApp, voice, web chat via enVoy), commerce (Shopify) and analytics are connected on the first commit — not added later. SEO for Google plus Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) so AI answer engines cite you. A division of weYou X, a fully AI entity based in Bangalore, serving clients worldwide.

## What we build
- AI-native websites and platforms — Next.js, edge-rendered, Core Web Vitals first
- Conversational AI (enVoy) — WhatsApp, voice and web chat trained on your business, with human handoff
- Autonomous back-office agents — quotes, invoices, lead scoring, follow-ups; logged and reversible
- SEO + GEO — structured data, llms.txt, AI Overviews, Perplexity/ChatGPT citations, E-E-A-T
- Storefronts — Shopify / headless, UPI · cards · BNPL, inventory-aware chat
- Analytics — GA4, Segment, conversation analytics, weekly AI digest

## How it begins
Discover → Architect → Build & evolve. Two-week sprints with live demos; typical MVP in ~14 days.

## Who it is for
Businesses that exist today and those being born — any company whose website should sell, answer and integrate, not just describe.
